casting.direction: An original American male trivia presenter around forty. Warm middle register, lean resonance, precise diction without theatrical over-enunciation, and agile conversational timing. The opening is inviting but skeptical; the sentence gathers momentum, then cools into an understated punchline. Varied pitch follows the meaning instead of a repeated melody. Dry studio recording, no commercial polish and no resemblance to a named person.

reference.transcript: Welcome to You're All Wrong. Tonight, four innocent buttons are about to become evidence. Read carefully, answer quickly, and remember: confidence is just a mistake wearing a nicer jacket.
